name: WIN-Partners Co., Ltd.
summary: WIN-Partners Co., Ltd., through its subsidiaries, engages in the sales of medical equipment in Japan. The company offers PTCA balloon catheters and intravascular ultrasound diagnostic catheters for Ischemic heart disease-related; cardiac rhythm management, includes space makers, implantable cardioverter-defibrillators, implantable cardioverter-defibrillators with biventricular pacing, catheters for electrophysiological testing, and catheters for myocardial ablation; and stent grafts, transcatheter bioprosthetic valves, artificial blood vessels, heart-lung machines for cardiovascular surgery.
